Mike Rivera: Heads-up — candidate Priya R. confirmed for hybrid onsite next Tue 10/5. Schedule I pulled together: arrive 09:30, 10:00 intro, 10:45 interview loop, 12:15 lunch, 13:00 take-home debrief. Can we confirm room, badge pickup, and a day-of point of contact?

Mike Rivera: Thanks. Kelly — can you share a mobile for the day-of so I can DM the candidate?
Kelly Ng: Day-of contact: +1 (415) 555-0198 (Kelly). I’ll also monitor #on-site-day Slack. :thumbsup:
Ashley Park: Office Wi‑Fi: SSID RedwoodGuest / password Welcome2027. Bring chargers; adapters available at reception. I’ll print visitor badge and a schedule sheet.
Dana Liu: Candidate flagged vegetarian — lunch ordered. Also confirming we’ll cover $40 cap on local rides; sync receipts to the expenses link.
